summary: Full E2E validation of iteration_2 new features: Snooze presets + auto-wake, Owner Insights 'What's Working', Batch Approval for Repeat Revenue only, Print/Export on Impact. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing (snooze/wake/auto-wake/insights/batch/eligibility/Maya-untouched). Frontend: Snooze menu (4 presets + custom), snoozed banner, wake-now, Snooze Queue tab shows Maya after snooze, Approval Center excludes snoozed items, BatchApprovalCard shows $548/2 recipients with correct criteria + exclusions, review dialog has 'Approve 2 Demo Drafts' button exact label, batch approve empties the card and leaves Maya untouched (Needs Approval), Impact page renders owner-insights + 3 workflow rows + recommendation + disclaimer + print-report-btn + export-report-btn (shows 'Exported ✓' + toast).
passed: POST snooze action sets status=Snoozed, snoozed_until, snooze_preset; audit gets 'Snoozed' event
POST wake_snooze restores previous status=Needs Approval and appends 'Snooze Ended' audit
Auto-wake: snooze with past timestamp -> subsequent GET auto-wakes and appends 'Snooze Ended'
GET /insights returns 3 workflow rows (wf-lead-rescue, wf-estimate-recovery, wf-repeat-revenue) with required fields + recommendation + disclaimer
GET /batch/repeat-revenue returns exactly 2 eligible (opp-denise, opp-aisha) totaling $548, plus criteria
POST /batch/repeat-revenue/approve marks both eligible as Sent, audit 'Approved (Batch)' + 'Sent', card recount 0
Maya (missed call), Carlos (new lead), Samuel & Jordan (open estimates) not in batch eligible list
Maya remains Needs Approval after batch approval (safety)
UI: /app/opportunities/opp-maya shows snooze-btn -> snooze-menu with preset 1h/tomorrow_9am/next_business/next_week + snooze-custom-input + snooze-custom-apply
UI: after preset click, snoozed-banner + wake-now-btn appear with correct wake time text
UI: /app/inbox has 6th tab 'Snooze Queue' (data-testid=tab-snoozed) - filters to snoozed items only (Maya shows with Snoozed badge)
UI: Approval Center shows batch-approval-card at top titled 'Seasonal Tune-Up Reactivation' with $548, '2 eligible recipients', criteria + Excluded blocks
UI: open-batch-review-btn opens batch-review-dialog with batch-preview + batch-recipients + confirm-batch-approve-btn label EXACTLY 'Approve 2 Demo Drafts'
UI: After confirming batch, toast appears, card recount becomes '$0 / 0 eligible recipients'
UI: /app/impact shows owner-insights card 'What's Working' + insights-table (3 workflow rows) + insights-recommendation + insights-disclaimer
UI: print-report-btn and export-report-btn present; export shows 'Exported ✓' state + success toast ('Impact report exported (simulated)')
Session persistence across sidebar nav confirmed (localStorage jobos.session_id stable across /opportunities -> /inbox -> /approvals)
critical_code_review_comments: Batch review dialog lacks per-recipient data-testid (e.g., batch-recipient-{id}) - only container batch-recipients has a testid. Non-blocking but would help automation.
Opportunity detail response does not include audit_trail; audit events are only accessible via GET /demo/{sid}/audit. Non-blocking, tests were adapted.
SessionContext reads localStorage on mount and validates via GET /demo/session/{id}; behaves correctly - confirmed no session drift across pages.
seed_data_creation: None - each test creates a fresh POST /demo/session
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new iteration_2 features validated end-to-end. Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covers snooze, auto-wake, insights, batch. Note: opp row testid on /app/inbox is 'inbox-row-{id}' not 'opp-row-{id}'. Batch confirm button label is EXACTLY 'Approve N Demo Drafts'. Audit events are at GET /demo/{sid}/audit (session-level), not embedded in opportunity.
